name: Market Match
description: Market Match is California's healthy food incentive program that matches CalFresh benefits dollar-for-dollar at participating farmers markets and other farm-direct sites, making fresh, locally grown fruits and vegetables more affordable.
fullDescription: Market Match is California's healthy food incentive program that matches CalFresh benefits dollar-for-dollar at participating farmers markets and other farm-direct sites, making fresh, locally grown fruits and vegetables more affordable.
whatTheyOffer:
- Dollar-for-dollar match of CalFresh EBT spending (most markets match up to $15; some match more)
- Match funds for fresh fruits, vegetables, fresh-cut herbs, and edible plant starts
- Available at 270+ sites statewide, including farmers markets, farm stands, CSAs, and mobile markets
- At farm stands and other farm-direct outlets, usually offered as a 50% discount
howToGetIt: Use the Farmers' Market Finder to find a participating site. At a farmers market, go to the information booth, have staff swipe your CalFresh EBT card for the amount you choose, and receive tokens or vouchers plus matching Market Match to spend on produce. Check with your market for its match limit.
keywords: Market Match, farmers market, CalFresh, EBT, double up, fresh produce, fruits vegetables, food stamps, local farm, farm stand, CSA
